# Agentic IDP workshop platform

> Internal developer platform used in the "Building Agent-Ready Internal Developer Platforms" workshop. Every workload, including agents, ships through one golden path: a folder under labs/*/apps/<name>/, validated in CI, applied by ArgoCD. Git is the only write path.

- [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md): rules for agents working in this repository
